text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a 2% APAC -> 2% EU canary for model v7 tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need quick alignment on the feature-flag key, emergency cutover command, and who owns the toggle.
kevin: I can own the flag. Which exact key are we using?
maya: We'll use `canary.model_v7.routing`. Split by region + percent. Plan: start 2% APAC, 2% EU, hold for 30m. Auto-cutoff if 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR latency_p95 > 800ms. CC @oncall-bot for runbook.
samir: Where are the guardrail thresholds stored? Can we make them editable in the flag config instead of hardcoding? Also want a short ops checklist.
elaine: Pushed a staging config snippet to the flags repo:
```json
{
  "flag": "canary.model_v7.routing",
  "regions": { "apac": 2, "eu": 2 },
  "cutoff": { "5xx_pct": 0.5, "p95_ms": 800 },
  "fallback": "model_v6",
  "owner": "kevin"
}
```
kevin: Ack. I'll open the PR to add the flag + rollout schedule and include the runbook section. Will add the `canary_runbook.md` link in the PR.
oncall-bot: Quick reminder: emergency cutoff command is `/feature toggle disable canary.model_v7.routing` and must be followed by a page to #eng-oncall. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/canary-cutoff.
maya: Can we also add a soft-failover to model_v6 for user-visible errors (not just direct route fallback)? Want a statement in the PR. Also confirm Grafana dashboard id for monitoring.
samir: Soft-failover is supported — we just need the flag to carry `fallback` as shown. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123/canary-v7?orgId=1 (panels for 5xx rate, p95, token throughput).
elaine: I'll add an alert rule that will page if either 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 800ms sustained for 5m. Will also add a mute window for test ramp.
kevin: Scheduling the ramp: 09:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll post a final sign-off 15m before start in this thread and tag @oncall-bot to start the automation.
maya: :thumbsup: Thanks — please speak up if you see any red flags by EOD.
oncall-bot: TEST NOTE: staging toggle applied `canary.model_v7.routing` -> regions: apac=2, eu=2 (staging). Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.com/canary-cutoff. If you need to cut, run `/feature toggle disable canary.model_v7.routing` and page #eng-oncall.
